item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-05
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. Notably, the `scienceverse/metacheck` project has added dedicated import and export functionality, while `giladfeldman/docpluck` has updated its documentation and addressed several fixes, including refusing sign flips and range bounds issues. Meanwhile, `Davidvandijcke/coarse` has enhanced its security with a hardened release audit and workflows, and `JamieCummins/regcheck` has resolved multiple bugs, including issues with the demo page, card preview, and survey routes. Additionally, `giladfeldman/escicheck` has synced changes from the escicheckapp repository, ensuring consistency across related projects. These updates demonstrate the connections and collaborations within our community, and we celebrate the progress made by our contributors, including Lakens, Gilad Feldman, David van Dijcke, and Jamie Cummins.

item.title: docpluck: 29 commits today
item.description:
giladfeldman/docpluck

Work was done on the `main` branch, where the documentation for findings was updated to note that the "plos_med column loss has a STRUCTURAL ceiling, not a threshold one" and that "header-seeding was PROTOTYPED then REJECTED by the corpus survey". The `docs(handoff)` section was also updated to correct the open-findings count and HEAD sha, record the cycle-3 gate state and canary evidence, and note that "v2.4.122 + v2.4.123 shipped, 3 audit claims disproved". Additionally, fixes were made, including refusing a sign flip against a CI that cannot hold a negative, and addressing issues with range bounds and grid-guard false negatives. The `docpluck-iterate` and `docpluck-review` sections were also updated, with the addition of hard rules, including surveying the corpus before writing a threshold and adding a universal-quantifier spot-check hard rule. A `chore` commit was made to complete the Dropbox->Vibe re-pointing that was left uncommitted from the 2026-08-03 move.
